deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a bibliographic list in two parts, written in two inks at two different times. Context: p.31 is headed 'Auf der Bibliothek nachzusehen' (to be looked up at the library), so these are most plausibly books and journal volumes Gauss noted for borrowing or reading, probably from the Göttingen University Library.

(A) Heading '1828.' (darker ink):
- Hippel's Werke, vols. 5–11 (Theodor Gottlieb von Hippel, collected works).
- Krünitz, Oekonomisch-technologische Encyklopädie, vols. 146–148.
- Prechtl, Jahrbücher des polytechnischen Institutes in Wien, vols. 11–12.
- Neue Annalen der Mecklenburgischen Landwirthschaft, year 1828.
- Annalen der Möglinschen Landwirthschaft (Thaer's Möglin academy), vol. 21.
- Annalen der Criminalrechtspflege, ed. Hitzig, vol. 2.
- Schlözers Leben, vols. 1–2 (life of A. L. von Schlözer, by Chr. von Schlözer, 1828).
- Cagnazzi, Über den Werth der Maaße und Gewichte bei den alten Römern (German translation, 1828).
- Hansard, Parliamentary Debates, vols. XVI–XVIII.
- Gergonne, Annales de mathématiques pures et appliquées, vol. 18.
- Mémoires de l'Institut de France (Académie des sciences), vols. 5–8.
- Mémoires présentés à l'Académie des sciences de l'Institut par divers savants (Savants étrangers), vol. I (1827).

(B) Heading '1837' (lighter brown ink; one digit of the heading is overwritten):
- Herling, Lehrbuch der Stylistik, vol. 1, Hannover 1837.
- Nebenius, Herabsetzung der Zinsen der öffentlichen Schulden, Stuttgart 1837.
- Varnhagen von Ense, Denkwürdigkeiten (und vermischte Schriften), vols. 1–2, Mannheim 1837.
- Göthe's Briefe in den Jahren 1768–1832, ed. H. Döring, Leipzig 1837.
- Franklin, Familiar Letters and Miscellaneous Papers, ed. Sparks, London 183[3/7].
- Marryat's Works, vols. 1–11, Leipzig.
- Lélia, par George Sand, Paris 183[3/7?].

There is nothing to reconstruct mathematically. The only mathematically relevant items are journal volumes: Gergonne's Annales vol. 18, the Paris Mémoires vols. 5–8, and Savants étrangers vol. I. These show Gauss keeping up with the French mathematical literature in 1828. The rest reflects his well-documented broad reading in agriculture, economics, law, history, politics and literature.

results.what: Reading/borrowing list of books and journal volumes for 1828 and 1837

deep.surprise_reason: Pure book list, with no mathematical content. Gauss's wide non-mathematical reading (English novels, Hansard, economics) and his use of the Göttingen library are well documented, e.g. from the library loan registers.
transcription_corrections: 'Möglinschen' is correct (Annalen der Möglinschen Landwirthschaft, Thaer); the manuscript spelling is roughly 'Möglinschen'.
The '1837' heading has an overwritten third digit (possibly altered from another year).
'Herling[?]' is probably correct: S. H. A. Herling, Lehrbuch der Stylistik, Hannover 1837.
In the Franklin entry the last digit of the date ('London 183?') is unclear in the image. The Sparks London edition appeared in 1833, but the ink could read 1837.
In 'Lelia par George Sand Paris 183?' the final digit is likewise unclear. The first edition is 1833, and a revised edition followed in 1839.
Hansard is written with a long s ('Hanſard'); 'Hansard' is the correct reading.
